course.title: Biological Sciences BSc | Imperial College London
quotes: Qualification BSc Duration 3 years Start date October 2027 UCAS course code C100
Delivered by Department of Life Sciences
Minimum entry standard AAA To include: A in Biology A in Chemistry, Mathematics or Physics A in a third subject
Minimum entry standard 38 points To include: 6 in Biology at higher level 6 in Chemistry, Mathematics or Physics at higher level

EITHER 5, 5, 5, 4, 4 to include 5 in Biology and 5 in one of Chemistry, Calculus (AB or BC), Physics (1 or 2 or C) OR 5, 5, 4 to include 5 in Biology and 5 in one of Chemistry, Calculus (AB or BC), Physics (1 or 2 or C) Award of acceptable school leaving qualification (e.g., US High School Diploma) Either 1460 in SAT or 31 in ACT.
Our minimum entry standard is 90% overall, to include: 90% in Biology 90% in Chemistry, Maths or Physics 90% Other
Our minimum entry standard is 1.6 overall, to include the following abiturprufung exams: 14 in Biology 14 in Chemistry, Mathematics or Physics
you will need to sit three ESAT modules: Mathematics 1 Chemistry Biology
must achieve the higher university requirement
